# Copy-upload host allowlist (optional lockdown).
#
# When this page has content, ONLY the listed hosts may be used for
# "Upload from URL" on Special:Upload. An empty list (this state) means
# every PUBLIC host is allowed; localhost/private/link-local targets are
# always refused by the SSRF guard in LocalSettings.php.
#
# Format: one host per line. '#' starts a comment. Wildcards are allowed
# per label, e.g. '*.wikimedia.org' or 'upload.*.gov.uk'.
#
# Example lockdown:
# upload.wikimedia.org
# github.com
# raw.githubusercontent.com
